messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: were running a product launch + benchmark teaser the week of 11/03. Need social schedule, seedlist, and a short reply playbook. Can someone own X/LinkedIn posting ops?
Diego Ramos: I can own posting ops. Prefer staggered drops: X thread + a boosted LI post.
Harper Wells: Ill write copy. Want to test two angles: 'cost savings' vs 'throughput improvements'.
Maya Chen: Target audience = infra PMs, ML platform leads, and startup CTOs. Ill prepare a segmented seedlist.
Omar Farouk: Creative ask: hero image + 2 slide carousel (benchmarks + takeaway). PNGs at 1200x628 and 1200x1200.
Nina Park: CTA = "See the benchmark + join the demo" register: https://redwood.ai/launch-nov2025. UTMs: utm_campaign=novlaunch2025&utm_medium=social&utm_source={twitter|linkedin}
Diego Ramos: Scheduling proposal:
- X root post 11/03 10:00 PT
- X pinned reply with registration + carousel 11:00 PT
- LI post 11/03 10:05 PT
- LI follow-up comment + quote card +1hr
Harper Wells: Draft X copy (cost angle): "New benchmark: real configs that cut inference spend up to 6x. Were sharing configs + code. 11/03. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/launch-nov2025 #MLInfra"
Harper Wells: Draft X copy (throughput angle): "Faster responses at lower cost: benchmark and tactics we use in production. 11/03 micro-demo. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/launch-nov2025"
Maya Chen: Seedlist link (draft): https://drive.google.com/seed/nov_launch_seed.csv  includes role, company size, timezone. Will flag enterprise accounts as priority.
Omar Farouk: Uploaded assets: https://drive.google.com/creative/nov_launch (files: hero_cost.png, hero_throughput.png, slide_bench_v1.png)
ops-bot: Reminder set: posting checklist due 11/03 09:00 PT.
Diego Ramos: Boost plan suggestion: $600 total split 70% X / 30% LinkedIn. Run for 8 hours starting at publish. A/B on X headline.
Nina Park: Engagement playbook (short):
- Monitor replies for first 3 hours
- If user asks about pricing/scale -> tag "high-intent" and push to SDR queue
- If user requests follow-up demo -> capture contact and assign to AE within 24h
Harper Wells: Pinned reply content will include 3 bullet takeaways + registration link. Also will request that ops pin the reply.
Diego Ramos: Will schedule posts in Buffer and pin the registration reply on X. Also will attach UTMs and creative variants.
Maya Chen: Ill hand the cleaned seedlist to SDRs immediately after publish. Mapping rules: click+no-attend -> follow-up within 24h.
Omar Farouk: Small note: add alt text for images for accessibility. Uploaded alt text file in creative folder.
Nina Park: Final ask: capture top 5 high-signal replies after first hour for potential quotes. Harper, can you curate?
Harper Wells: Yep, will curate and drop candidates into the shared doc.
Diego Ramos: All set on my side. Scheduling shortly.
Nina Park: Thanks team  tagging this as green to publish unless anyone objects. :rocket:
